name: Spotted-tailed quoll
desc: Tasmania's top hunting mammal, living in rainforest and wet forest and taking possums, pademelons, wombats and crayfish.
about: The tiger quoll, also known as the spotted-tailed quoll, spotted quoll, spotted-tailed dasyure, or tiger cat, is a carnivorous marsupial of the quoll genus Dasyurus native to Australia.
